## Goal
- Complete end-to-end owner login recovery per owner's final acceptance gate: secure password reset via official email, verified session revocation, service-role key rotation, zero secrets in repo, new APK v1.4.6/versionCode 38, physical Android QA, SHA-match deployment proof — mark VERIFIED only when all gates pass.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Status must stay FAILED/PARTIAL/BLOCKED until real phone test passes** — no narrative PASS reports; final output requires 7 status lines (OWNER LOGIN / SESSION REVOCATION / SECURITY ROTATION / ANDROID APK / PHYSICAL DEVICE QA / PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT / FINAL)
- **SECURITY**: never print/persist/log any password; owner sets new private password via official Supabase reset email only; owner must NOT paste password into chat
- Only real mobile path counts: `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({email, password})` — no service-role tokens, magic links, admin tokens, fixtures, mocks, or password injection as proof
- 20-test owner auth QA matrix + 30-test physical Android QA required; do not reuse APK build 37 as final proof
- Password login / magic-link / OTP / cached-session flows must be isolated; Remember Me must never store password
- Service-role key must be rotated (was hardcoded in repo; Git history retains it); mobile/web bundles must not contain it; add automated secret scanning
- Expo/React Native is ACTIVE production app; use `bun`/`bunx`; owner token expires ~15 min — refresh via `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login`
- Repo writes go via backend `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `github_commit_file` + confirmText `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`; Render actions via `render_upsert_env_var`/`render_trigger_deploy`/`render_restart_service` etc.
- Query Render directly for deployment proof; do not infer from reports

## Progress
### Done
- **Password rotated securely**: admin API set random in-memory password (HTTP 200, never printed/persisted); old exposed password PROVEN rejected (HTTP 400 `invalid_credentials`, no token); passwordless owner login still works (`sessionMethod=magiclink_token_hash`, `passwordPreserved=True`)
- **Owner user verified in production project `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb`**: ID `9b280e15-f9fd-459f-bf2d-530b1ed84cb1`, email confirmed, not banned/deleted, providers `[email, phone]`, exactly 1 matching account
- **Session revocation VERIFIED with real production sessions**: local logout `POST /auth/v1/logout?scope=local` HTTP 204 → own refresh token rejected (400 `refresh_token_not_found`), other session unaffected; global logout `?scope=global` HTTP 204 → refresh token rejected + old access token 403; admin per-user `/admin/users/{uid}/logout` returns 404 (NOT SUPPORTED on this GoTrue — documented replacement = user-JWT global logout)
- **All 5 secret-bearing repo files redacted and pushed to main**: `backend/ivx-owner-registration-supabase-mismatch.test.ts` (commit `1b5bf83`, TEST_PASSWORD → synthetic fixture; regression test passes after `bun add @supabase/supabase-js`), `expo/scripts/audit-owner-ai-members-live.mjs` (`7a7b766`), `expo/scripts/audit-visitors-members-live.mjs` (`6dee149`), `backend/scripts/capture-live-screenshots.mjs` (`72dc82e`), `expo/scripts/audit-ivx-ia-identity-brain.mjs` (`0be00fd`) — all secrets replaced with env lookups; repo scan afterward found matches only in files just fixed
- **Version bumped for new APK**: `expo/app.config.ts` → version `1.4.6`, versionCode `38`, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_17_BUILD_38_AUTH_SECURITY_RELEASE`; `expo/android/app/build.gradle` → versionCode 38 / versionName "1.4.6"
- Prior deployed backend fix: password-preserving passwordless login (commit `7a25832`); env `IVX_OWNER_REGISTRATION_EMAILS=iperez4242@gmail.com` on Render serviceId `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- `/health` currently reports commitSha `6dee149066f3` (auto-deploying redaction commits)

### In Progress
- **Gradle release build running**: `cd expo/android && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon -x lint` → log `/tmp/gradle-build.log`; `bun install` in expo/ completed (1339 packages); ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk present
- Mobile auth isolation audit: reviewed `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx` — found owner "self-healing" fallback that calls owner-access-repair to set the typed password on invalid_credentials (potential conflict to assess); Remember Me stores only `ivx_remember_me` boolean in SecureStore (no password persisted); cold-launch uses `signOut({scope:'local'})`

### Blocked
- **Password reset email**: Supabase `/auth/v1/recover` returns HTTP 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` on 3 retries (last 18:26Z) — must retry after limit clears (~1h)
- **Service-role key rotation**: requires Supabase dashboard access (owner action); old key still valid; also in Git history
- **Physical Android device QA + screen recording**: requires owner's phone; cannot be done from sandbox
- Sandbox env vars UNSET: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET, GITHUB_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (S3 APK upload via `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` needs AWS creds; must route through backend or GitHub Actions)

## Key Decisions
- Root cause confirmed: earlier "repair" set a password the owner never chose (from repo test fixture) — phone entry could never match; process failure, not config mismatch
- Rotate password via admin API to random in-memory value first (immediate lockout of exposed credential), then official reset email lets owner set own private password
- Admin logout endpoint unsupported (404) → use user-JWT `logout?scope=global` as the verified revocation method
- Build new APK locally with gradle (versionCode 38) rather than EAS; release currently signed with debug keystore (`signingConfigs.debug` used for release in build.gradle — flag in report)
- All secret redactions committed through production backend developer-deploy pipeline (no local git creds)

## Next Steps
1. Monitor `/tmp/gradle-build.log` until `:app:assembleRelease` finishes; get APK at `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`, compute SHA-256
2. Commit version-bump files (`expo/app.config.ts`, `expo/android/app/build.gradle`) to main via developer-deploy
3. Upload/publish APK (S3 key pattern `apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.6.apk` via `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` — needs AWS creds; consider `github_dispatch_workflow` or GitHub Release via backend)
4. Retry password reset email once 429 clears; record sent timestamp
5. Verify deployment SHA triple-match (GitHub HEAD == Render deploy == `/health` commitSha) using backend render/github actions
6. Run scannable secret checks on built APK bundle (strings scan for service-role JWT / owner token)
7. Assess/possibly remove owner self-healing password-repair fallback in `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx` (conflicts with "password login must call signInWithPassword only")
8. Produce final gated report: statuses PARTIAL/BLOCKED where owner action (reset email click, phone QA, key rotation) is pending — never VERIFIED prematurely

## Critical Context
- Production Supabase ref `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb`; old ref `biikwnqdhsdzyxecekht` only in test files; mobile pins ref in `expo/lib/supabase-env.ts`
- Passwordless login response keys: accessToken, refreshToken, userId, expiresAt, sessionMethod, passwordPreserved, deploymentMarker
- Owner repair endpoint V7: `requiresClientPassword=True`, `passwordUpdateSource=client_request`, phone must submit `newPassword`; `sendPasswordReset` defaults true
- Reset redirect resolver in `expo/lib/auth-password-recovery.ts`: default `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password`, rejects `api.*` hosts
- Backend deploy-control actions available: github_commit_file/create_branch/create_pull_request/dispatch_workflow/merge_pull_request, render_trigger_deploy/restart_service/upsert_env_var/update_source, etc.
- Gradle 8.14.3, JDK 17, Node v22.22.0, bun 1.3.9; `adb` present but no device attached
- Old APK build 37 SHA-256 starts `9447d174a397...` (superseded; not final proof)

## Relevant Files
- `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx`: main auth flow; owner self-healing repair fallback (~line 1750-1900); loginOwnerPasswordless + setSession (~1648-1700); signOut usages (138, 1139, 1363, 1557, 2011)
- `expo/lib/auth-password-sign-in.ts`: line 42 `client.auth.signInWithPassword` — the exact real phone path
- `expo/lib/supabase-env.ts`: pins production Supabase ref, rejects foreign refs
- `expo/app.config.ts` + `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: bumped to 1.4.6/38 (uncommitted); release uses debug keystore
- `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs`: S3 APK uploader (needs AWS env creds)
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-registration.ts`: owner-access-repair handler (line 1153+)
- `backend/ivx-owner-registration-supabase-mismatch.test.ts`: redacted fixture; passes
- `expo/scripts/audit-owner-ai-members-live.mjs`, `expo/scripts/audit-visitors-members-live.mjs`, `expo/scripts/audit-ivx-ia-identity-brain.mjs`, `backend/scripts/capture-live-screenshots.mjs`: redacted, secrets → env lookups
- `/tmp/gradle-build.log`, `/tmp/bun-install.log`: live build logs
- `expo/app/login.tsx`: reset flow (line 759), rememberMe boolean-only storage (502-517)
